content: We all have reservoirs of life to draw upon, of which we do not dream.
author: William James
story:
At its core, this reflection cuts through our everyday excuses. We spend enormous energy trying to present a sanitized, perfect version of ourselves to the world. But whatever emotions or desires we push into the dark don't disappear; they run our lives from behind the curtain.

Across his life and work, William James saw how easily we surrender our tranquility to fear, vanity, and distraction. True maturity isn't pretending you have no dark corners—it is having the honesty and courage to look at your jealousy, fear, and anger in the daylight so they no longer control your actions.
reflectionPrompt: What hidden motive, insecurity, or fear might be silently driving your recent reactions?
